description: This file defines an Angular component 'DocumentEditorComponent' that provides an interface for editing and saving document details such as title and content.

classes.name: DocumentEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing document details with inputs for document data and editability, and an output for saving changes.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component state with the current document title and content when the component is initialized.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with the updated document information when the user triggers a save.
